_about: Estimated Bitcoin network hash rate from the current difficulty. Structural variable only; no price or energy-cost data.

sources.note: raw 80-byte header; identical bytes from mempool.space /header

last_retarget_block.checks: header bytes identical across both explorers; SHA256d(header) equals block hash; hash <= target(nBits); difficulty recomputed from nBits equals explorer value

sources.note: raw 80-byte header; identical bytes from mempool.space /header

tip_block.checks: header bytes identical across both explorers; SHA256d(header) equals block hash; hash <= target(nBits); difficulty recomputed from nBits equals explorer value

formula.difficulty: D = target(0x1d00ffff) / target(nBits), where target(bits) = mantissa * 256^(exponent-3)
formula.assumption: One block is found on average every 600 s (the protocol target). 2^32 is the expected number of hashes per block at difficulty 1. If actual block intervals differ from 600 s, the true hash rate differs proportionally; this is an estimate, not a measurement.

comparison_only.note: Explorer-published figures shown for comparison; neither this file's estimate nor these is asserted to be the true value.
